tools.name: classify_ai_system
tools.description: Classifies an AI system into the EU AI Act risk tiers (prohibited, high, limited, minimal) from 9 facts about it. Returns the tier, a compliance score, findings with the legal article, the documents the tier requires, and a link to the saved report. Ask the user for any fact you do not know instead

tools.name: estimate_ai_act_fine
tools.description: Maximum administrative fine under Articles 99 and 101 of the EU AI Act for a violation type, given worldwide annual turnover, including the lower-of rule for SMEs (Art. 99(6)).

tools.name: generate_ai_disclosure_notice
tools.description: Ready-to-paste "you are interacting with an AI" notices required by Article 50 of the EU AI Act, for chat, voice and AI-generated content, in up to 8 EU languages (en, es, de, fr, it, pt, nl, pl).

tools.name: list_ai_act_deadlines
tools.description: Every application date of the EU AI Act after the 2026 Digital Omnibus (Regulation (EU) 2026/1744): what applies, to whom, the legal basis and how many days are left.
